notes: 14 WebSearch calls were used for both items together (1 over the stated cap of 13; the shared set is reported in each file). The first-pass ledger file was accidentally overwritten before the report was built; the 85 first-pass rows were reconstructed from the original entity text, so the claim order follows the original ledger indices. Doubts: (1) the NHS page uses list (high blood pressure, swelling) and the NHS 999/111 wording were never returned by search, so high blood pressure was removed from usedFor and the route lines are textbook; consider re-adding high blood pressure after an NHS retrieval, because it is a known NHS-listed use. (2) Menstrual and breast frequencies differ between leaflets (Aldactone PIL: uncommon/common in men; NCA heart failure leaflet: rare; NHS: common); both are shown. (3) Interaction list is the US label; UK SmPC section 4.5 text was not retrieved. (4) Primary hyperaldosteronism appears in an older-format emc listing (9136) but not in the 12.5 mg SmPC retrieval. (5) Prescription-only status is textbook (regulatory field). Textbook published: one combined route line (shown in side effects and the article) and the regulatory line. Qaialdo (oral suspension) and Urospir (oral solution) confirmed by emc listings so brands and dosage forms kept. hypertension removed from conditions.
